gaps.note: DoD SAFE files downloaded to browser session, then manually uploaded to SPO document library. No local storage on BYOD device — browser-only enforcement via Conditional Access App Control prevents local download. Flow: SAFE portal (TLS 1.2+) → browser session → manual upload to SPO CUI document library.

CKE not deployed. Microsoft-managed keys satisfy SC.L2-3.13.10 via FedRAMP High inheritance from the CSP. SSP Section 13.10 documents this inheritance. CKE may be evaluated post-production if contractually required by a prime.

No additional CUI egress paths beyond Teams/SPO sharing and Exchange email. Power Platform disabled at tenant level (GCC High default restrictions). No third-party SaaS connectors configured. Graph API usage (Stamper automation) reads from tenant for evidence collection — does not transmit CUI externally. Sentinel forwards logs to Log Analytics Workspace (internal to Azure Gov subscription), not to external SIEM. No scheduled exports or backup forwarding configured.

Retention set to 7-year norm (2555 days) across all CUI workloads: Exchange mailboxes, SPO sites, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats, Teams channel messages, Teams files. Confirm policy is applied in M365 Compliance Center → Data Lifecycle Management → Retention policies at go-live.

Browser-only access model confirmed. Authorized CUI processing tools: Office Online (Word, Excel, PowerPoint — browser), Teams web, Outlook web. No desktop applications authorized for CUI creation/modification. No CAD or line-of-business applications in scope. Conditional Access App Control enforces browser-only sessions.
